name: SSDlite detector (lightweight)
description: A very small, very fast detector that works at a fixed 320 px, so it only suits objects that are large in the patch. Usable without a graphics card. Starts from a network already trained on everyday photographs, so it learns from few examples.

choices.label: MobileNet - fits any graphics card, or none

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.

settings.label: Learning rate
settings.help: How big each learning step is. The default suits most projects.
